title: My work

scan.label: Scan the bundle to start
scan.hint: Scanning the real bundle starts it: no row to pick

none.title: Nothing ready to start yet
none.body: Every task here waits for something: see why in the list. Scan a bundle to work on it.

gone.title: No longer in the queue
gone.body: It was finished or the plan changed. Go back to the list.

scanToStart: Scan the bundle to start it.

cantFind.title: Can't find it?
cantFind.body: Call for help, or put it last and go on with the next one.

held.offline: This tablet has no network and has not read who to call yet: ask your team leader.
held.failed: The office does not answer, so nobody can be called from here: ask your team leader.
held.noStation: A call goes out from a station, and this tablet is at none: ask your team leader.
held.noType: This site has no material call yet: the office sets it (Production › Floor rules & codes).
held.open: A material call is already open at this station: someone has been told.
held.waiting: Your material call is saved on this tablet: it goes when the network is back.

putLast.said: {number} · Op {seq} put last on this tablet ({reason}). The office's plan does not change.

error.title: Could not load the queue
error.body: Scan a bundle to work anyway.

offline.body: The queue comes from the office the first time. Scan a bundle to work anyway.

noStation.title: This tablet is not at a station
noStation.body: The office places it at one (Admin › Devices & printers). Scan a bundle to work on it.

nothingPublished.title: No plan published yet
nothingPublished.body: Work from the bundles until the office publishes the plan.

firstUpcoming.title: The first plan, v{number}, starts at {time}
firstUpcoming.body: Until then, scan a bundle to work on it.

nothingQueued.title: Nothing queued for this station
nothingQueued.body: Scan a bundle to work on it.

allDone.title: Everything planned here is done
allDone.body: Scan a bundle to work on it.

warehouse.title: The warehouse task list is not here yet
warehouse.body: It comes with picking and put-away. Work from the tiles on Home. If this tablet belongs to a station, the office places it (Admin › Devices & printers).

noPermission.title: Nothing to do here with your role
